Scenario fixture: a11ycore-form-control-programmatic-label-present

This file includes many edge cases to exercise applicability, eligibility (acc-tree), and label mechanisms. Each form control has a stable id of the form fc_case_XX. Expected behavior notes are written per the rule: valid label mechanisms are <label>, aria-label (non-empty), and aria-labelledby (resolves to non-empty text). placeholder and title do not count as labels.

A. Baseline (eligible, should be checked)

01 — FAIL: visible input missing any label mechanism
No label / aria-label / aria-labelledby.
02 — PASS: <label for> association
03 — PASS: wrapping <label> association
04 — PASS: aria-label (non-empty)
05 — PASS: aria-labelledby resolves to non-empty text
Username
06 — PASS: select with label
07 — PASS: textarea with wrapping label

B. aria-label and aria-labelledby edge cases

08 — FAIL: aria-label present but empty
Empty aria-label should fail.
09 — FAIL: aria-labelledby points to missing id
10 — FAIL: aria-labelledby resolves but text is empty
11 — PASS: aria-labelledby with multiple ids (one has text)
Postal code
12 — FAIL: aria-labelledby with multiple ids (all empty)
13 — PASS: aria-labelledby with duplicate id tokens (dedupe)
Phone
14 — PASS: aria-labelledby present + aria-label present (labelledby wins, still OK)
City

C. Placeholder and title (must NOT count)

15 — Pass: placeholder-only
16 — Pass: title-only
17 — Pass: title only

D. Role presentation/none behavior

18 — it is eligible (focusable) so it should fail, not “neutral/ineligible”
Should be excluded (not focusable).
19 — FAIL (eligible): role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0) and unlabeled
Focusable overrides exclusion; still must have label mechanism.
20 — PASS (eligible): role=none but focusable + aria-label

E. Hidden from the accessibility tree (acc ineligible) + focus/IDREF exceptions

21 — it is eligible (tabbable by default) so it should fail
22 — FAIL (eligible exception): aria-hidden=true but tabbable (tabindex=0), unlabeled
Per helper: tabbable overrides aria-hidden eligibility.
23 — PASS (eligible exception): aria-hidden=true but tabbable, aria-label present
24 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden=true but programmatic focus only (tabindex=-1)
Per helper: tabindex<0 does NOT override aria-hidden eligibility.
25 — FAIL (eligible exception): aria-hidden=true and referenced by IDREF (aria-labelledby)
References the control via IDREF.
Helper may keep referenced nodes eligible.
26 — PASS (eligible exception): aria-hidden=true and referenced by IDREF, aria-label present
References the control via IDREF.

F. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible in acc)

27 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
28 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
29 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden (on ancestor)

30 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert subtree

Closed details

32 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inside template

33 — NOT TARGETED: input type=hidden
34 — NOT TARGETED: input type=submit
35 — NOT TARGETED: input type=button
36 — NOT TARGETED: input type=image

37 — FAIL: disabled input with no label mechanism
38 — PASS: disabled input with label
